title: Nectarine Crumble
description: A classic British dessert made with fresh nectarines and a crunchy crumble topping, perfect for a warm summer evening.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sliced nectarines, granulated sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Transfer the nectarine mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, combine cubed fatty (butter), gluten-free flour, and oatmeal.
Add brown sugar to the flour mixture and stir until crumbly.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the nectarine filling.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
